author: ItzAidan
body:
So Lets Begin.

When you do /stafflist in game and no one is online and someones hacking what do you do?

I think you should add a messaging program on the forums so if no one is online, we can see if a mod is online on the forums (bottom left corner) and message them asking them if they can get online to watch this guy or this guy is hacking. I think its another good way of communicating. If we wanted, we could do a /report kinda thing on here and its for strictly sending a report to the mods. I dunno. I think this should be added.
-Cardioo/Aidan
